instruction: Can you set the maximum volume in VLC to 200%? I have some videos with low audio and need to boost the volume beyond the default limit.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
